en: Arrive at the Right Gate: Airport, West Station, or Lanzhou Station
zh: 到哪一站下：机场、西站与兰州站
ja: どこで降りるか：空港・蘭州西駅・蘭州駅

p.src: Landing at Zhongchuan Airport is not the same as reaching central Lanzhou. T3 connects to the integrated transport centre; for a rail transfer, the relevant station name is Zhongchuan Airport East (中川机场东). The flight, rail ticket, and lodging remain separate bookings. Collect baggage, confirm the departure station and time on the rail ticket, then choose rail, an airport coach, or a road transfer. The plan is finished when that choice reaches the city segment where the first night begins.

caption.zh: 中川机场T3只是抵达兰州的第一站，不在市中心；转乘铁路时，还要继续找到“中川机场东”。
caption.ja: 中川空港T3は蘭州で最初に着く場所で、市街中心ではない。鉄道へ乗り継ぐなら、次に「中川机场东」を探す。
caption.en: Zhongchuan Airport T3 is the first arrival point, not central Lanzhou. A rail transfer still requires the next label: Zhongchuan Airport East.

p.src: This diagram does not show journey times. It connects each of the three arrival gates to a first city segment. The airport lies to the north and appears in a separate, not-to-scale panel; Lanzhou West begins in the western segment, while Lanzhou Railway Station begins in the east. The two national-rail gates also use different metro-station names. Start with the gate printed on the ticket, place the lodging and first visit in the west, centre, or east, and only then check the live transfer.

caption.zh: 先读票面的完整入口名，再把住宿与第一站放到西段、中段或东段；机场框与市区不共比例尺。
caption.ja: 券面の到着口を正式名で確認し、宿と最初の目的地を西、中央、東の区間に置く。空港枠は市街図と同じ縮尺ではない。
caption.en: Read the full ticketed gate, then place the lodging and first stop in the west, centre, or east. The airport panel is not to the city scale.

p.src: Consider rail when a bookable departure reaches a station on the lodging side of the city. Choose an airport coach when it is operating that day and its stop suits the first segment. A taxi or ride-hailing car can remove a transfer for a group, heavy luggage, a late arrival, or a door-to-door trip. No mode is always fastest. Before departure, check operation, boarding and alighting points, and the full destination address separately; for a road transfer, confirm the pickup area from the signs on arrival.

p.src: Do not subtract the scheduled flight arrival from the rail departure and call the whole difference transfer time. Disembarkation, baggage, walking, ticket checks, and flight delay all consume that margin. If the train is essential, allow an interval that can absorb delay and write down the missed-connection sequence before booking: check later bookable trains, a coach that is still operating, then a road transfer. Without a fallback you can actually use, the connection is too fragile.

p.src: On the national-rail ticket, the gate appears as Lanzhou West Railway Station (兰州西站); for the metro transfer, look for Lanzhou West Station North Square (兰州西站北广场). The two names refer to adjacent interchange points, but they are not identical. Follow current signs inside the station rather than guessing an entrance from a single map point. West Station belongs to this guide's western segment. If the first stop is Gansu Provincial Museum or Qilihe, there is usually no reason to cross the centre first. Decide where the luggage goes, then use Line 1 or a ground route operating that day.

caption.zh: 兰州西站的大屋顶和前广场是辨认这座西侧车站的线索；转地铁时要另找“兰州西站北广场”。
caption.ja: 大屋根と駅前広場は蘭州西駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。地下鉄へ移る時は、別の表示名「兰州西站北广场」を探す。
caption.en: The broad roof and forecourt help identify Lanzhou West. For the metro, look separately for Lanzhou West Station North Square.

p.src: Keep the luggage stop, Gansu Provincial Museum, and the first meal in one west-to-east segment, and the day can begin at Lanzhou West without a backtrack. If the lodging is around Xiguan or the central segment, check Line 1 operation and the final walk; for a more distant address or bulky luggage, compare a direct taxi or ride-hailing transfer. Do not visit the bridge first and return to Qilihe for bags merely because West Station and Zhongshan Bridge fit on one map page. Confirm the actual pickup point from the signs after arrival.

p.src: On a national-rail ticket, the gate appears as Lanzhou Station (兰州站). On Metro Line 2, follow the connected stop name 兰州火车站. The labels are different even though the two stations form an interchange. This is the guide's eastern rail gate, well placed for a first segment around Lanzhou University, Dongfanghong Square, or eastern lodging. If the first night is around Xiguan, Qilihe, or Lanzhou West, the journey does not shrink because the ticket says only ‘Lanzhou’. Put the westward transfer into the plan.

caption.zh: 钟面、站房与近山是辨认东侧兰州站的线索；住在西段时，要把向东横穿城市的一段写进路线。
caption.ja: 時計、駅舎、近い山並みは東側の蘭州駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。西側に泊まるなら、東へ市内を横断する区間を旅程に入れる。
caption.en: The clock, station frontage, and nearby hills identify Lanzhou Station on the eastern side of the city. From western lodging, plan the eastbound cross-city transfer.

p.src: For Dongfanghong Square, first check whether Line 2 is running when you arrive. For Xiguan or farther west, decide where to transfer and how far the final walk will be. ‘Into town’ is not a route. Compare a direct taxi or ride-hailing trip if you arrive late, are travelling in a larger group, or have luggage that makes the interchange awkward. Internal passages, accessible routes, construction barriers, and pickup areas can change; follow current signs rather than building the itinerary around a presumed exit.

p.src: On line one, copy the full ticketed gate: Zhongchuan Airport T3, Zhongchuan Airport East, Lanzhou West, or Lanzhou Railway Station. On line two, copy the lodging's full Chinese address, not only its English name. On line three, name the first visit and a transport option that currently operates. When the three lines form one route you could actually follow, save a fallback. If they do not align, change the arrival gate, lodging segment, or first stop before travel rather than solving it after landing.
